gloss: middle school student, junior high school student

definitions.gloss: middle school student, junior high school student
definitions.explanation: A student attending 中学校, which covers grades 7-9 (ages 12-15) in the Japanese education system.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}です。
examples.english: My daughter is a middle school student.

examples.japanese: {中学生|ちゅうがくせい}のとき、{部活|ぶかつ}でテニスをしていた。
examples.english: When I was in middle school, I played tennis in my school club.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}でも{分|わ}かる{内容|ないよう}です。
examples.english: This movie has content that even a middle school student can understand.

notes:
FORMATION:
{中学|ちゅうがく} (middle school, abbreviation of {中学校|ちゅうがっこう}) + {生|せい} (student). The suffix ～{生|せい} is used for students at all levels: {小学生|しょうがくせい} (elementary), {高校生|こうこうせい} (high school), {大学生|だいがくせい} (university).

JAPANESE SCHOOL SYSTEM:
・{小学校|しょうがっこう} — elementary school (6 years, ages 6-12)
・{中学校|ちゅうがっこう} — middle school (3 years, ages 12-15)
・{高校|こうこう} — high school (3 years, ages 15-18)

{中学生|ちゅうがくせい} is often abbreviated to {中学|ちゅうがく} in casual speech: {中学|ちゅうがく}のとき (when I was in middle school).
